Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=orders.total_price DESC]
    Project[orders.id AS order_id, customer.name AS cust_name, customer.nation AS nation, orders.total_price AS total_price, orders.order_date AS order_date]
      Filter[customer.nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND orders.total_price > 1000.0]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=orders.cust_id = customer.id]
          Scan[orders]
          Scan[customer]
